newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms against dollar, 469/$ close.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms against dollar, 469/$ close.

text.p: Strong demand for bolivar- denominated assets such as stocks and Central Bank TEM paper mopped-up bolivar supplies firming the unit to a surprisingly strong 469.00/470.00 per dollar close, traders said.
On Monday the bolivar closed at 471.75/473.00 per dollar.
Most bolivar orders came from "foreign investors, pursuing the stock market, and the interbank market that was chasing TEM orders," said one trader.
While demand for bolivars was high, "with the domestic economy in a strong recession, demand for dollars to finance imports is also very low," said one trader.
Between the combined forces of low dollar demand and high bolivar demand, the bolivar has firmed 1.2 percent since last week when it closed Tuesday at 475.20/70 per dollar.
Traders said the Central Bank did not participate in today's market and only observed.
